title: Immigration enforcement and the decision to call for help
discussion_signal: The post describes people who called police as victims or witnesses and then became exposed to immigration enforcement, with the discussion emphasizing fear, reduced reporting, and weakened trust in public safety systems. It connects institutional contact to practical avoidance rather than treating reporting as a neutral choice.
linked_research_question: How can enforcement exposure change whether people report victimization, seek help, or trust public safety institutions?
limits: The post reports selected cases and journalism, not population prevalence
Individual accounts are not causal estimates
The platform discussion is not representative public opinion
